question: Which measuring instrument consists of a metal triangular frame supported on three legs, used to measure the radius of curvature of an object such as lenses and curved mirrors which are spherical in shape?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spherometer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Spherometer**

 
 
• A spherometer is a precision instrument used to **measure** the **radius of curvature of a spherical surface**.
 
• It is commonly used in fields such as optics and mechanical engineering to measure the radii of curvature of **lenses**, **mirrors**, and other **curved surfaces**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03590750a1ca92f27a05c058ea0cf278e3db6ec8dd9f297a1f58751598822e0c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Viscometer**

 
 
• A viscometer is an instrument used to measure the **viscosity** or **flow properties of fluids**. 
 
• There are many different types of viscometers, including **capillary viscometers**,** rotational viscometers**, and **falling ball viscometers**.
 
• They help to determine the **shear rate**, **shear stress**, and **yield stress** **of fluids**, which are used to predict how they will behave under various conditions.
 
 
 
• **Verniercaliper**
 
 
• A Vernier caliper is a precision measuring instrument used to measure the** internal **and **external dimensions** of an object with **high accuracy**.
 
• It consists of **two scales**, the **main scale**, and the **Vernier scale.**
 
• The **main scale** of the Vernier caliper is typically marked in **millimeters** or **inches.**
 
• The **Vernier scale** is a secondary scale that slides along the main scale and has smaller graduations, allowing for more precise readings.
 
 
 
• **Screw gauge**
 
 
• A screw gauge, also known as a **micrometer screw gauge**, is a precision measuring tool used to measure the **diameter of small objects** with high accuracy.
 
• It consists of a **C-shaped frame**, **a spindle**, **a thimble**, and** a screw**.
